name: DrivingGen
summary: 从视觉质量和机器人轨迹物理合理性两方面评测自动驾驶生成式视频世界模型的基准。
summaryEn: A benchmark evaluating generative driving video world models through both visual quality and physical plausibility of vehicle trajectories.
scale: Diverse driving evaluation set; 14 model families benchmarked
scaleZh: 多样化驾驶评测集，论文评测 14 个模型系列
licenseZh: 代码采用 Apache-2.0；数据许可见发布页
accessZh: 数据集已在 Hugging Face 提供
verdict: 同时衡量驾驶视频观感与轨迹物理一致性的生成基准
verdictEn: A generative driving benchmark covering visual and trajectory-level physical consistency
wmNote: 将视频指标与轨迹恢复指标结合，适合诊断驾驶世界模型。
wmNoteEn: Combines video metrics with recovered trajectory metrics to diagnose driving world models.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2601.01528] DrivingGen: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Generative Video World Models in Autonomous Driving
evidence.statement: Dedicated driving world-model evaluation measures trajectory plausibility, temporal consistency and control conditioning; source clips overlap existing datasets.
